item.title: These are the Vegas Golden Knights who won medals at the Olympics
item.description: The 2026 Winter Olympics are officially over, and several Vegas Golden Knights players came home from Italy with medals around their necks.

item.title: Las Vegas music teacher arrested on sex charges
item.description: Metro police are asking for possible additional victims to come forward following a Las Vegas teacher's arrest Monday.

item.title: Red Cross of Southern Nevada urges donations as winter storms cancel blood drives across U.S.
item.description: As winter storms and a major blizzard in the northeastern United States continue to force blood drive cancellations, the Red Cross of Southern Nevada is urging people to donate to help the straining national supply.

item.title: Nevada election leader: SAVE Act has ‘unintended consequences’ rooted in conspiracies
item.description: Nevada Secretary of State Cisco Aguilar called attempts in Congress to implement new voter registration requirements and voter identification the “unintended consequences” of election conspiracies.

item.title: Snapchat loses bid to block Nevada lawsuit over harm to children
item.description: Nevada Attorney General Aaron D. Ford announced a major legal victory on Monday after the Nevada Supreme Court rejected an appeal from Snap Inc., the parent company of Snapchat, allowing the state’s lawsuit against the social media company to proceed in district court.

item.title: Man shot in face, critically injured in Las Vegas
item.description: A shooting in the central Las Vegas valley has left a man critically injured after he was shot in the face, according to Las Vegas Metro police.

item.title: Las Vegas HOA considers bulletproof glass for meetings
item.description: A Las Vegas homeowners association considered purchasing bulletproof glass for their meetings, but some neighbors say a more pressing concern lies with where their money is going.

item.title: Man accused of shooting, killing man after fight involving North Las Vegas high school student
item.description: A man is accused of shooting and killing another man following an arranged fight involving a Legacy High School student, according to an arrest report.

item.title: Man admits to firebombing Teslas at Las Vegas collision center
item.description: A man who firebombed several Tesla vehicles at a Las Vegas collision center last year pleaded guilty Monday to all the charges against him.

item.title: Woman who abandoned dog at Las Vegas airport didn't want to miss flight, police say
item.description: A woman who abandoned her dog at the Las Vegas airport reportedly told an airline employee to call “animal control” over concerns she would miss her flight, according to documents the 8 News Now Investigators obtained Monday.
